headline: DB instance unexpectedly marked for update; verify plan consistency
suppressed: 38 checkov failures are pre-existing conditions in the stack (RDS encryption, S3 versioning, VPC Flow Logs, etc.) and not introduced by this PR. The CostCenter tag addition itself is appropriate for billing purposes.

findings.evidence_ref: plan.txt shows aws_db_instance.main marked for in-place update, but tags are unchanged (only Name tag present in both before and after state, no CostCenter tag added). This PR only modifies VPC and internet gateway tags.
findings.explanation: The plan shows aws_db_instance.main will be updated even though the PR description and network.tf modifications only target the VPC and internet gateway. The before and after tags are identical, suggesting this update may be unintended. Before merging, verify that the plan is current and that applying it won't cause unexpected modifications to the database instance.
